hostPorts.purpose: Resolve destination-based sales tax quotes without Ordering owning tax rules.

quotes.purpose: Own tax quote contracts, local quote behavior, and future provider integration shape.
quotes.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

nexus.purpose: Own state-by-state sales tax nexus thresholds, collection-readiness posture, and provider-dependency tracking.
nexus.allowedWhen: Required when marketplace launch needs to distinguish no-collection launch readiness from provider-backed tax collection readiness.
expectedConsumers: Platform API production Tax quote gating

routes.purpose: Reserve tax-owned route metadata for future API contributions.
routes.allowedWhen: Required by bounded-context structure metadata even when the context does not yet contribute routes.
